{{Short description|Russian Virologist}}
'''Lev Stepanovich Sandakchiev''' ({{Langx|ru|Лев Степанович Сандахчиев}}; 11 January 1937 in [[Rostov-on-Don]] – 29 June 2006 in [[Koltsovo, Novosibirsk Oblast|Koltsovo]]) was a Soviet and Russian scientist, specialist in molecular biology and virology, Doctor of biology, Professor, and Academician of [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]. He was the founder and the first head of [[State Research Center of Virology and Biotechnology VECTOR]], director of it from 1982 to 2005.
